about: rubyToJa(ruby, {parse, ...table}): the Japanese in the standard form (written also when there are errors) and the errors (on Ruby lines). The Ruby is parsed with prism. "none" is no table of a Ruby system.

cases.title: local variables, blocks and operators are written in the standard form
cases.ja:
x = 1
x < 10 and not (x == 5) の間繰り返す:
    x += 2

cases.title: a call the table does not have is told as an error at its name

errors.message: 「move」は日本語では書けない命令です
errors.name: move

cases.title: the post-test loop is told on its begin and while lines

errors.message: 後判定の繰り返しは日本語では書けません
後判定の繰り返しは日本語では書けません

cases.title: blank lines and comments are kept
cases.ruby:
# はじめ
x = 1

if x > 0 # x が正
  x = 2
end
cases.ja:
# はじめ
x = 1

もし x > 0 ならば: # x が正
    x = 2
